title: tectaria fragilis
intro: Tectaria fragilis, commonly known as the fragile fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, as well as therapeutic actions like wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Tectaria fragilis include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
